description: This file defines a utility class for Base64 encoding and decoding, used within the source map feature of a SCSS compiler or processor. It provides methods to encode integers to Base64 characters and decode Base64 characters back to integers, supporting the source map generation process.

classes.name: Base64
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for Base64 encoding and decoding of integer values used in source map encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Converts an integer value to its corresponding Base64 character.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Converts a Base64 character to its corresponding integer value.
